buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Not Applicable Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Area Manager(HR) or his authorized representative 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Applicability of e-PBG @ 5%(Security Deposit): YES ( Details mentio ned in Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC of GeM Bid). 2) Address for submission of EMD/e-PBG/PBG(if applicable) : AREA MAT ERIALS MANAGER ,Office of the General Manger, Sonepur Bazari Area, ECL P.O.- Bahula, District Paschim-Burdwan, West Bengal- 713322 Note: “Demand Draft for EMD should be in favour of Eastern Coalfields Limited A/c Sonepur Bazari Area”.

Submission of Bills and Supporting Documents: For claiming payment, the following documents shall be submitted to t he consignee: · 6 copy of Invoice either with seal and Stamp or Digitall y signed · Valid E-Way Bill (Part A and Part B) Submit the following documents in hard copy (two sets), duly stamped and signed on the Company letterhead—one set for Stores and one set for Finance—as per the GeM Contract and ATC: Documents: · Guarantee/Warranty Certificate as per GeM ATC format · Certificate confirming that the firm has never been banned or blacklis ted · Price Certificate as per GeM ATC format · Price Fall Clause Certificate as per GeM ATC format · GeM Undertaking · Test Report(if applicable) · EPBG (if applicable) · PBG (if applicable) · GeM Contract Copy · GeM Invoice · Fitment Guarantee(if applicable) · Delivery Extension (if applicable) · Technical Service as per GEM atc · Identification Marking (if applicable)/Packing List Other Documents mentioned in GEM ATC 4) Additional Terms and Conditions 1. Sample Verification Before Printing: A sample/proof of the printed forma t shall be submitted by the successful bidder for inspection and approval by the concerned authority before commencement of bulk printing. 2. Paper GSM Approval: A sample of the paper along with its GSM (Grams per Square Meter) specification shall be submitted for verification and approval bef ore commencement of printing. 3. Printing Quality: The printing quality must be neat, clear and legible. Smud ging, ink spreading, blurred printing, misalignment or any other printing defects

shall not be accepted. Materials found defective shall be liable to rejection. 4. Binding Quality: The binding quality of registers and other bound materials must be maintained as per the approved specifications. Any material found to h ave poor or unsatisfactory binding quality shall be rejected and replaced by the supplier at no additional cost. . 7.
